objective: forward the exact eager DXVK pipeline-layout create and destroy boundary through the glibc-to-Bionic bridge with native ownership and no pointer transport

wire.representation: canonical little-endian flags, counts, push ranges, typed 64-bit object IDs, and an explicit zero descriptor-layout sentinel
wire.native_reconstruction: the Bionic service resolves same-device descriptor-set-layout IDs, preserves null independent-set slots, builds local VkDescriptorSetLayout and VkPushConstantRange arrays, and calls native vkCreatePipelineLayout with a local VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo

push_constant_range.derivation: 64 shared bytes plus 32 bytes for each graphics stage truthfully exposed by the fake Adreno profile

fail_closed: unsupported pipeline-layout flags or shader-stage bits
null set-layout slots without independent-sets semantics
wrong-type, missing, or cross-device descriptor-set-layout IDs
overlapping push-constant stage masks, unaligned ranges, overflow, or ranges beyond 256 bytes
over-limit counts, length mismatches, and nonzero reserved wire bytes

ownership.returned_handle: typed BVB_OBJECT_PIPELINE_LAYOUT ID backed by a real native VkPipelineLayout
ownership.explicit_destroy: vkDestroyPipelineLayout removes the typed object and forwards the native handle
ownership.device_teardown: remaining pipeline layouts are destroyed before descriptor pools, samplers, and descriptor-set layouts

dispatch_policy.manifest: the immutable E011 DXVK manifest records both commands at device scope with seven lookups each
dispatch_policy.promotion: vkCreatePipelineLayout and vkDestroyPipelineLayout move from required_unimplemented to executable

verification.canonical_codec: round trips the exact variable-length request and rejects reserved-byte and wrong-handle-type corruption
verification.cross_process_fake_driver: observed the exact three-slot layout topology, flags, graphics-stage mask, 160-byte range, native non-dummy handle, and destruction order

first_remaining_eager_null_entry.derivation: the null fragment library compiles immediately after its independent pipeline layout; DxvkShaderPipelineLibrary::compileFragmentShaderPipeline submits one graphics-pipeline-library create

reuse: The required deja search found no prior pipeline-layout implementation. Reused E045's loader-private/local-pointer rule and E046/E056's canonical fixed-width typed-object ownership and native reconstruction patterns.
scope: Host transport and native fake-driver proof only; no Android deployment, Turnip pipeline creation, DXVK adapter acceptance, Tomb Raider frame, or FPS claim
